candidates.rationale: Same idea: rank quality long, rank recent price extension short. The parent's second leg is just 'where does today's price sit in its trailing 21-day range', expressed the long way as a guarded ratio of the run-up above the 21-day trough to the 21-day mean high. TS_RANK($open, 21) is that same position measure by construction, already scale-free, so the division, the epsilon and two price fields all drop out. Fields 4 -> 2, depth 5 -> 3, constants stay 0. Both legs remain cross-sectionally ranked, so the difference stays balanced the way the parent was (parent rho 0.715 vs RANK($roa) is almost exactly the 0.707 of two uncorrelated equal-variance legs, so neither leg is being dropped or reweighted). Rank-based extension is also robust to the raw-OHLC split artifacts that corrupt TS_MIN/TS_MEAN of unadjusted prices for a full window, so the reversal leg should retain its IC rather than lose it. Kept $open rather than switching to $close to avoid mixing the raw and adjusted price scales and to stay on the parent's own field.

candidates.changed_node: the volatility leg TS_MEAN($high - $low, 10) / (TS_MEAN($open, 10) + 1e-8) replaced by TS_STD($return, 10), removing $high, $low, $open and the guarded division
candidates.rationale: Same idea: a signed quality tilt amplified in high-volatility names and damped in low-volatility ones. The parent's right leg is a 10-day Parkinson-style volatility proxy written as mean high-low range over mean open; TS_STD($return, 10) is the same 10-day realized volatility over the same horizon in one field, needing no price-level normaliser and no epsilon guard. Fields 4 -> 2, depth 5 -> 3, constants stay 0. Only the volatility rank enters the product, and range-based and close-to-close volatility order the cross-section nearly identically, so the interaction that carries the IC is preserved. Left leg untouched: CS_DEMEAN is what gives the product its sign structure, and rank-then-demean keeps fat-tailed ROE from being driven by outliers, so it is the component doing the work. Dropping $high - $low also removes the 3-node overlap with alpha101 that the parent was carrying, and using $return keeps the expression clear of rank(stddev(high, 10)) in alpha040.

prompt:
You are proposing quantitative factor expressions for US large-cap equities.

Universe and data
- S&P 500 point-in-time constituents, roughly 500 names per day.
- Daily bars only, plus point-in-time quarterly fundamentals stamped from the
  report date. Every field is referenced with a leading `$`:
    $open $high $low $close $adj_close $volume $dollar_volume $return
    $roa $roe $operating_margin $leverage $asset_turnover
    $book_per_share $earnings_per_share $accrual_gap
  A bare name such as `close` is not a field and will be rejected.
- Execution convention: the signal is computed after the close of day T and the
  position is entered at the open of T+1.
- The window these factors are fitted and judged on runs from 2000 to 2013.
  Do not reason about anything later; you will never be shown a number from
  outside that window.

Syntax
- Operators are function calls: TS_MEAN, TS_STD, TS_MAX, TS_MIN, TS_RANK,
  TS_DELTA, TS_CORR, TS_COV, TS_SUM, TS_PRODUCT, TS_ARGMAX, TS_ARGMIN,
  TS_DECAY_LINEAR, EMA, DELAY, DELTA, RANK, ZSCORE, CS_RANK, CS_ZSCORE,
  CS_DEMEAN, IF, IF_ELSE, MIN, MAX, ABS, SIGN, LOG, LN, SQRT, POWER, BOUND,
  COUNT.
- Lookback windows must be positive integer literals, e.g. TS_MEAN($close, 21).
- Guard every division with a small epsilon: `/ (TS_STD($close, 21) + 1e-8)`.
- Well-formed example: -RANK(TS_CORR(RANK($close), RANK($volume), 5))

Hard limits every proposal must satisfy, or it is rejected before it is scored
- at most 200 characters
- at most 5 distinct `$fields`
- at most 4 free numeric constants (lookback windows and
  the 1e-8 epsilon guard do not count)
- expression tree depth at most 6
- must not share a complete sub-expression of 4 or more
  nodes with any published Alpha101 formula, or with any factor already in the
  archive. Restating a published alpha is the one thing that is always rejected.
- must cover at least 90% of the panel
- absolute rank correlation below 0.80 against every archive member

Output
- Return valid JSON only, matching the supplied JSON schema. No prose outside it.


TASK: SIMPLIFY. Each expression below was flagged as more complex than it needs
to be. Return a simpler expression that keeps the same idea.

Simpler means strictly fewer distinct fields, fewer free constants, or less
depth. The simplification is accepted only if it also keeps at least
80% of the parent's fit-window |IC|, so do not remove the component
doing the work. Put the parent's id in `parent_ids` and name what you removed in
`changed_node`.
